metadata.description: Price per square meter estimates for cities missing price data in the database - Arab/Bedouin towns and settlement cities
methodology: For cities with direct transaction data (from madadirot, madlan, yadata), those values were used
For Triangle region Arab cities (כפר קאסם, טייבה, קלנסווה, etc.), estimates based on regional comparables and known transaction ranges
For Galilee Arab cities (סח'נין, טמרה, etc.), benchmarked against Nazareth (8,500-10,000/sqm) and Carmiel (10,500-12,500/sqm)
For Negev Bedouin cities (רהט, חורה, לקיה, etc.), based on madadirot data showing Rahat at ~3,500/sqm, smaller towns estimated lower
For Druze towns (עספיא, מג'דל שמס), estimated based on local market characteristics
For settlement cities (כוכב יעקב, קריית ארבע, קרני שומרון), based on madlan/madadirot transaction data
2023 values estimated as ~10-15% below 2026 values, reflecting national price growth trends (7.7% in 2024 + moderate 2025-2026 growth)

Arab sector real estate typically trades 30-60% below Jewish sector in same region due to: limited formal market, lower demand from outside, construction on private/unregistered land, smaller buyer pool
Bedouin Negev towns have extremely limited formal apartment market - most housing is private construction

confidence_notes.high: Direct transaction data available from madadirot/madlan/yadata
confidence_notes.medium: Estimated from regional comparables and known market characteristics
confidence_notes.low: Very limited transaction data; rough estimate based on regional minimums and market knowledge

cities.notes: Near Jerusalem, touristic village with higher prices than typical Arab towns. Proximity to Jerusalem drives demand. Estimated based on Jerusalem periphery pricing.
Small Arab village near Nazareth. Limited formal market. Estimated below Nazareth levels.
Small Arab village in Lower Galilee near Nazareth. Very limited formal transaction data.
Small Bedouin village in Galilee. Very limited formal apartment market.
Arab town near Wadi Ara/Hadera corridor. Limited data, estimated between Nazareth and Triangle levels.
Arab village near Kiryat Tivon and Haifa area. Slightly higher than deep Galilee towns due to Haifa proximity.
Arab village in Western Galilee near Carmiel. Limited formal market.
Larger Arab town near Acre. More active market than smaller villages. Proximity to Acre and Western Galilee drives some demand.
Triangle region, near Kfar Saba. Central location boosts prices above typical Arab town levels. Part of densely populated Triangle corridor.

Coastal Arab town. Direct data: 81sqm apartment sold for 701K (8,657/sqm) under mechir lamishtaken in 2024. Market prices higher - luxury units near beach sold at 40,000+/sqm. Using mechir shuk estimate excluding subsidized units. Source: Globes 2024.
Arab town in Upper Galilee. Limited formal apartment market. Estimated at lower end of Galilee range.
Arab town in Galilee near Sakhnin. Similar pricing to neighboring villages.
Small Arab village in Triangle region near Tulkarm border. Limited data, estimated below larger Triangle towns.
Bedouin town in Jezreel Valley near Nazareth. Limited formal market.
Bedouin town in Negev. Very limited formal apartment market. Most construction is private/informal. Estimated slightly above Rahat minimum.
Arab village in Upper Galilee near Rosh Pina. Limited formal market.

Largest Triangle city (~45K residents). Central location between Netanya and Kfar Saba. Active local market with some new construction. Yadata page available. Prices higher than typical Arab towns due to central location and city size.
Large Arab city (~44K) in Western Galilee near Acre. Active local market. Prices below Jewish cities in same area but above smaller villages.
Arab village in Western Galilee. Limited formal market. Similar to other small Galilee villages.
Bedouin town in Negev. Minimal formal apartment market. Among the lowest property values in Israel.
Druze-Arab village in Western Galilee. Slightly higher than pure Arab villages due to Druze community stability.
Arab town near Nazareth with religious tourism significance. Some new construction activity. Estimated slightly below Nazareth.
Arab village in Lower Galilee. Limited formal market data.
Triangle city adjacent to Rosh HaAyin. Major new construction planned (1,600 units). Central location near Gush Dan drives higher prices. Active madlan/yad2 market.
Arab town in Wadi Ara corridor near Hadera. Part of Route 65 corridor with reasonable access to Haifa and center.
Bedouin town in Negev near Arad. Very limited formal apartment market. Among lowest property values in Israel.
Druze town in Golan Heights. New construction planned. War in Syria (2024) increased interest in Israeli residency. Unique market with limited supply. Source: TheMarker 2024.
Arab village near Nazareth. Similar pricing to Nazareth periphery.
Arab village in Western Galilee. Limited formal market.
Large Arab city (~30K) in Galilee. More developed local market. Mechir lamishtaken projects with 60K grant eligibility. Prices below Carmiel but above smaller villages.
Arab village near Nazareth. Similar pricing to Nazareth periphery.
Arab village near Nazareth. Part of Nazareth metropolitan area.

Druze town on Mount Carmel near Haifa. Daliyat al-Karmel mechir lamishtaken project: 85sqm at 754K (8,870/sqm) and 100sqm at 882K (8,820/sqm) - these are 28-39% below market. Market price estimated ~12,000-14,000/sqm for new; average including older stock ~10,500.
Arab town in Wadi Ara/Triangle. On Route 65 with good access. Similar to Kafr Qara pricing.
Bedouin town in Negev. Very limited formal apartment market, similar to other Bedouin Negev towns.
Coastal Arab village near Caesarea/Zikhron Yaakov. Coastal premium but limited market. Near affluent areas but internal market is separate.

Jewish suburban community in Sharon area. Direct data from madadirot: 2023 price ~23,630/sqm for 4-room, ~19,083/sqm for 5-room. Weighted average ~21,000. 2026 estimated with ~15% growth. Active madlan market.
Arab city in Triangle near Netanya. Slightly below Taibe due to smaller size and less central location.
Mixed Druze-Christian Arab village in Upper Galilee. Limited formal market.

Largest Bedouin city (~78K). Direct madadirot data: avg purchase price 700K, avg 3,500/sqm. Only 4 transactions in past 12 months - extremely limited formal market. Most housing is private construction on unregistered/disputed land.
Bedouin town in Negev. Minimal formal apartment market. Among lowest property values in Israel.
Arab village in Galilee near Acre. Limited formal market.
Bedouin town in Negev near Beer Sheva. Very limited formal apartment market.

Religious-Zionist settlement near Jerusalem. Active madlan market. Growing community with new construction. Prices reflect Jerusalem periphery demand plus ideological premium. Below Beit Shemesh but above typical Judea settlements.

Settlement city adjacent to Hebron. Madlan data shows avg ~1,265K, with sqm range 7,142-16,900. Wide range reflects mix of old and new stock. Using median estimate. Ideological/security factors limit buyer pool.
Settlement city in Samaria. Direct madadirot data: avg purchase price 1,991K, avg 11,765/sqm. 19 sales in past 12 months. 10,924 residents. Avg rent 4,000/month.
